provenance.dataset: FlyWire FAFB v783 (full brain, materialization mcns_v1.0)
provenance.modulatory_contact_note: modulatory (da/ser/oct) contacts are separate synapses from fast contacts on the same pair; they are stored in modulatory_edges, not edges
provenance.nt_vote_rule: syn-count-weighted majority of contributing rows; ties -> alphabetically smallest NT
provenance.sign_rule: edge sign comes from the majority NT via NT_TABLE; never voted independently

assumptions.glutamate: uniformly excitatory (approximation; real-fly CNS glutamate is mixed)
assumptions.modulators: da/ser/oct carry no fast synaptic weight (sign 0); oct treated as modulatory per P0 scope decision
assumptions.weights: raw synapse counts, not calibrated efficacies
assumptions.layers: neuron layer = dominant output neuropil (alphabetical tie-break)

conversion: identical to fly_demon_3d.html buildSim init block (WS=0.02)
